name: saved chat goals continue, charge uncached tokens, obey controls, and stay in their own chat

artifacts.caption: Goals continue at an idle boundary and finish with their own proof
artifacts.description: A real managed engine wrote both checkpoint files across two turns, then called update_goal to complete. The unrelated chat has no goal.

results.expectation: Goals continue at an idle boundary and finish with their own proof
results.evidence: A real managed engine wrote both checkpoint files across two turns, then called update_goal to complete. The unrelated chat has no goal.

artifacts.caption: A saved token limit uses uncached input and all output exactly once
artifacts.description: Each real provider reply reported 130 input tokens with 100 cached, and 20 output tokens including 5 reasoning. The 60-token goal stopped after two 50-token replies at 100 used. Resume did not reset the limit or usage. Editing the limit to 120 preserved the same goal id and stopped at 150 used.

artifacts.caption: Pause and clear are saved controls for one chat
artifacts.description: Pause took effect while a provider reply was held. The current turn finished without another automatic request. Restart preserved the paused goal and its identity. Resume completed it with the same identity, and clear removed it. The other chat remained unchanged.

results.expectation: Pause and clear are saved controls for one chat

artifacts.caption: Stopping one goal does not restart it or stop another chat
artifacts.description: The native abort route saved paused before forwarding Stop. After the held reply was released, the goal sent no new request. The other chat produced a normal reply and did not acquire the stopped goal.

results.expectation: Stopping one goal does not restart it or stop another chat
results.evidence: The native abort route saved paused before forwarding Stop. After the held reply was released, the goal sent no new request. The other chat produced a normal reply and did not acquire the stopped goal.

judgments.expectation: Stopping one goal does not restart it or stop another chat
judgments.reasoning: The native abort route saved paused before forwarding Stop. After the held reply was released, the goal sent no new request. The other chat produced a normal reply and did not acquire the stopped goal.

artifacts.caption: Plan mode, Build selection, and request authentication are honored
artifacts.description: Saving in Plan launched no work. An unauthenticated resume was rejected. A real manual Plan reply spent no goal tokens or work time. Selecting Build resumed the same active goal and stopped after two charged replies at the saved budget.

results.expectation: Plan mode, Build selection, and request authentication are honored
results.evidence: Saving in Plan launched no work. An unauthenticated resume was rejected. A real manual Plan reply spent no goal tokens or work time. Selecting Build resumed the same active goal and stopped after two charged replies at the saved budget.

judgments.expectation: Plan mode, Build selection, and request authentication are honored
judgments.reasoning: Saving in Plan launched no work. An unauthenticated resume was rejected. A real manual Plan reply spent no goal tokens or work time. Selecting Build resumed the same active goal and stopped after two charged replies at the saved budget.

artifacts.caption: Active goal recovery uses the saved identity
artifacts.description: The managed server restarted while the first reply was held. Reading the saved active goal reconciled engine state and admitted one continuation. The same goal completed, and the unrelated chat stayed unchanged.

results.expectation: Active goal recovery uses the saved identity
results.evidence: The managed server restarted while the first reply was held. Reading the saved active goal reconciled engine state and admitted one continuation. The same goal completed, and the unrelated chat stayed unchanged.

artifacts.caption: Old turn events cannot charge a replacement goal
artifacts.description: The old provider reply arrived after a new objective was saved. The replacement used exactly its two 50-token replies and stopped at 100, with a new identity. The old reply did not spend its budget.

results.expectation: Old turn events cannot charge a replacement goal
results.evidence: The old provider reply arrived after a new objective was saved. The replacement used exactly its two 50-token replies and stopped at 100, with a new identity. The old reply did not spend its budget.

judgments.expectation: Old turn events cannot charge a replacement goal
judgments.reasoning: The old provider reply arrived after a new objective was saved. The replacement used exactly its two 50-token replies and stopped at 100, with a new identity. The old reply did not spend its budget.

artifacts.caption: Same-goal user input preserves earlier token use
artifacts.description: A new user prompt arrived while the first goal reply was held. Both replies counted toward the same saved goal, so its 60-token limit stopped at 100 after two requests.

artifacts.caption: Queued input has a server-visible admission hold
artifacts.description: A hold was registered before saving the goal. Across four observations spanning the continuation timer, the goal stayed active at zero tokens with no provider calls. Releasing the hold admitted work and preserved the saved goal identity and limit.

artifacts.caption: Empty continuations stop after three turns
artifacts.description: Three real empty replies stopped automatic work. Explicit resume retained the saved goal and allowed a fresh three-turn audit before stopping again.

artifacts.caption: Child work belongs to its parent goal budget
artifacts.description: A real engine child read no inherited goal and wrote its assigned file. Its three provider replies and the parent's three replies counted once, for 300 tokens. The child and unrelated chat had no saved goal.

results.expectation: Child work belongs to its parent goal budget
results.evidence: A real engine child read no inherited goal and wrote its assigned file. Its three provider replies and the parent's three replies counted once, for 300 tokens. The child and unrelated chat had no saved goal.

judgments.expectation: Child work belongs to its parent goal budget
judgments.reasoning: A real engine child read no inherited goal and wrote its assigned file. Its three provider replies and the parent's three replies counted once, for 300 tokens. The child and unrelated chat had no saved goal.

artifacts.caption: Goal tools work through the real agent engine
artifacts.description: On an explicit user request the engine executed create_goal with a 500-token limit, get_goal, and update_goal complete. Only the three replies after goal creation were charged, for 150 tokens. The stored result matches the requested objective, and the unrelated chat stayed unchanged.
